options.name: Elo
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Deliver exactly ONE minimalist professional brand SYMBOL ONLY, for a premium biometric smart footwear brand.
No typography of any kind: zero letters, zero monograms, zero initials, zero words, zero numbers, zero caption. It must be an abstract standalone icon, not an alphabet glyph. A brand icon rather than a stock illustration.
Flat single-color solid opaque cyan ink, exact #20D8F8. All surrounding empty space fully transparent with real alpha. No glow, no shadow, no gradients, no lighting, no texture, no white or additional colors, no background rectangle, no app tile.
Square 1024x1024 canvas. One carefully centered symbol taking up approximately 50 percent of the canvas width and height, with abundant transparent clear space. Crisp vector-like flat design, a refined deliberate silhouette, precise negative space and sensible stroke or shape thickness, clear even at small size.
No ECG, heartbeat, heart, shoe, footprint, lightning bolt, Wi-Fi, radio waves, medical cross, decorative circuitry or chevrons. No mockup, grid, frame, presentation text or watermark.
Direction: an organic movement link. A single compact solid asymmetrical loop with a beautifully controlled, slightly inclined capsule-like negative space, and one small clean lateral opening. A low broad silhouette, not a circular ring. The outer contour is taut and continuous, the loop feels engineered and fluid, subtly suggesting connection and forward movement. Vary the mass very slightly to create directional tension while retaining calm balance. No infinity shape, no chain link pair, no letterform. One exceptional simple silhouette, quietly premium.
